description: Concept Maps / Knowledge Graph - Visual prerequisite map showing topic dependencies across the CFA curriculum. Highlights which topics are prerequisites for others, shows mastery status, and explains why a student struggles with a topic based on unmastered prerequisites (e.g. 'You struggle with Duration because you haven't mastered TVM').
steps: Create src/features/knowledge-graph/ directory with types/, utils/, components/, data/, and __tests__/ subdirectories

Create src/features/knowledge-graph/types/index.ts with interfaces: ConceptNode (id, name, subject, topic, prerequisites: string[], description), ConceptEdge (from, to, relationship: 'prerequisite' | 'related'), KnowledgeGraphData (nodes, edges), NodeMasteryStatus (nodeId, mastery: 0-100, questionsAnswered, accuracy)

Create src/features/knowledge-graph/data/concept-map.ts defining the CFA Level I concept dependency graph. Include at least 40-50 key concept nodes across all 10 subjects with prerequisite edges. Examples: TVM -> Bond Pricing -> Duration -> Convexity, Basic Stats -> Regression -> Hypothesis Testing, Income Statement -> Ratio Analysis -> DuPont, Demand/Supply -> Elasticity -> Market Structures, WACC -> NPV -> Capital Budgeting

Create src/features/knowledge-graph/utils/graph-analyzer.ts implementing: (1) getPrerequisiteChain(nodeId) - returns ordered list of prerequisites, (2) findWeakPrerequisites(nodeId, masteryData) - identifies unmastered prerequisites explaining struggles, (3) getRecommendedPath(masteryData) - suggests next concepts to study based on prerequisite satisfaction, (4) computeNodeMastery(nodeId, attempts) - maps practice data to concept mastery
Create src/features/knowledge-graph/utils/mastery-mapper.ts that bridges PracticeAttempt data to concept nodes by mapping question topics to graph nodes, computing per-node mastery scores

Create src/features/knowledge-graph/components/knowledge-graph-view.tsx - interactive visualization rendered as a tree/force-directed layout using SVG. Nodes colored by mastery (red=weak, yellow=partial, green=mastered using theme colors). Clicking a node shows its prerequisites and recommended study path. Responsive layout.

Create src/features/knowledge-graph/components/prerequisite-alert.tsx - a component that given a weak topic, explains WHY via unmastered prerequisites (e.g., 'You struggle with Duration because you haven't mastered Time Value of Money')
Create src/features/knowledge-graph/components/study-path.tsx - renders the recommended learning path as a vertical timeline showing next concepts to tackle in order

Create src/features/knowledge-graph/__tests__/graph-analyzer.test.ts testing: (1) getPrerequisiteChain returns correct ordered chain, (2) findWeakPrerequisites identifies unmastered prereqs, (3) getRecommendedPath recommends foundational concepts first, (4) handles circular dependency gracefully, (5) nodes with no prereqs return empty chain

Create src/features/knowledge-graph/__tests__/mastery-mapper.test.ts testing: (1) maps practice attempts to node mastery correctly, (2) handles topics with no matching node gracefully, (3) aggregates across multiple attempts
Add route page at src/app/(protected)/learn/concepts/page.tsx rendering the knowledge graph view
Add 'Concept Map' navigation link in the Learn section or as a sub-route accessible from the Learn page
acceptance_criteria: Running npm run test passes all new tests
npx tsc --noEmit passes with zero errors
Concept graph contains at least 40 nodes with meaningful prerequisite relationships across all 10 CFA subjects
Graph analyzer correctly identifies prerequisite chains
Prerequisite alerts explain weak performance via unmastered prerequisites
Knowledge graph visualization renders all nodes with mastery coloring
verification: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run test
eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run build
